sn46.12:1.1: “Bhikkhus, this is the forerunner and precursor of the rising of the sun, that is, the dawn.
sn46.12:1.2: So too, bhikkhus, for a bhikkhu this is the forerunner and precursor of the arising of the seven factors of enlightenment, that is, good friendship.
sn46.12:1.3: When a bhikkhu has a good friend, it is to be expected that he will develop and cultivate the seven factors of enlightenment.
sn46.12:2.1: “And how does a bhikkhu who has a good friend develop and cultivate the seven factors of enlightenment?
sn46.12:2.2: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops the enlightenment factor of mindfulness,
sn46.12:2.3: which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release…. He develops the enlightenment factor of equanimity, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release.
sn46.12:2.4: It is in this way, bhikkhus, that a bhikkhu who has a good friend develops and cultivates the seven factors of enlightenment.”
